ignorePatterns.comment: mailto: links have no HTTP status to check
Localhost dev URLs are example documentation endpoints, not live servers in CI
Absolute paths on a contributor's own machine, never resolvable for anyone else (see docs/pr-16-submission-form.md)
GitHub Projects (v2) boards require an authenticated, JS-rendered request and 404 to a plain HTTP check even when the board exists and is public
Friendbot only responds to requests with an ?addr= query string; a bare fetch of the host is expected to 400
Soroban RPC is a JSON-RPC endpoint that only accepts POST; a bare GET is expected to 405
docs.iln.finance is an internal staging domain not reachable from CI; ignore link check
Nextra-internal routes (absolute paths like /protocol-overview) are page paths resolved by the Next.js build, not static files or URLs; the docs site build validates them
